context.description: Create the scenario supervisor with its judge round

evidence.trustReason: Re-verification after the earlier rejection (fix a92dc6cda8, test-only; scenario.ts unchanged since 0fbe7ddf34). supervise-scenario 8/8 and state-audit 5/5 pass (13/13, run twice; the new test also alone). Happy Path: test 1 asserts exactly one stored fact scenario.verified S2 trusted (bun toMatchObject on arrays checks length), the verifier marker and the judge line, one claim owned by scenario:<run>:S2 with watch false, judge-notes.md removed by the root restore, and the run actor folds S2 to trusted. SV6: a provided failing judge worker on a SimulatedClock gives no fact after tries 1 and 2, then exactly one rejected fact 'harness error: the judge of S2 broke' after try 3. State Transitions: test 8 sends a fresh unit.moved with S2 out of verifying, and the prompt count stays 1 (a broken verifying guard would start a new judge round); the waiting-S2 part of test 6 gets no prompt and no fact; test 7 gives status stopped; the claim (test 1) and the S2-only hook.verdicts filter (tests 2, 3) prove hook ownership. SV9: hook.ready and hook.repeated record nothing; stored types are exactly [scenario.verified]; a non-verifying scenario gets no judge. Boundary: the reading of missing (verdict called without this scenario's id) is sound. It matches the spine round (ask, collect, askMissing, collect) and the prior runner's two-session retry, and test 4 proves that a judge that never calls verdict gets no askMissing. Earlier gap closed: test 3 has a judge that always answers S9 and asserts exactly 4 prompts. Each session has one ask and one askMissing (the same session, then a new session), there is no third prompt in a session, and one fact is recorded: rejected 'no verdict'. A looping askMissing never records (timeout) or gives more than 4 prompts; a missing second session gives 2; an askMissing in a new session fails the session checks. SV27: a hung judge turn and actor.stop cancel exactly that session, nothing is stored after 200 ms, and the status is stopped. Concurrency N/A. Non-blocking: test 8's title promises a re-judge that the test never sends, and its latest:false check cannot fail; missingAsked is redundant under the current structure. Neither one is a T2.9 test case.
